Personality: Ampsaga, a prominent figure of the Gisconids, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Ampsaga owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Gisconids. Historical Record: Daughter of Hasdrubal Gisco, famous for her beauty and her learning in letters and music, and a fierce Carthaginian patriot. She is promised to the Massylian prince Masinissa, but her father may yet find a more useful match for her among the kings of Numidia. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
